project.name: screening-tool
project.productType: Self-hosted customer and vendor screening compliance workspace

must: Keyboard navigation and visible focus states
Exact ITA disclaimer first run and Settings
Review queue is the primary workflow
First-run wizard must create administrator before any protected page
avoid: Claims that a party is approved or compliant
Invented record counts in implemented UI

decisions.decision: Use calm navy and teal workspace with warm off-white background, compact data tables, low-radius panels, and restrained typography.
decisions.source: Design specification and agent selection under user authorization for unattended implementation.

evidence.use: Retrieved public component; adapted compact progress count and derived checklist state using native semantic HTML. No animation dependency or catalog code copied.

evidence.detail: 21st AI enabled but hosted sketch generation returned: Sketch is temporarily unavailable. Fewer than three models are healthy. Local source review blocked by automatic approval review to avoid transmitting project content.

Claude Opus 5.5 (first-party claude-opus-5-5, high effort, session daed6127-c517-4c72-a3f6-12fbfec7b81f) authored CSL overview, settings panel, status hook, responsive styles and Playwright contract tests through no-tool structured output. Sol integrated the existing App and verified browser state handling.
